tagShapeMismatches.english: The suite contains personal items equivalent to two rolls on the "Gems or Art Objects" column of the {@table Treasure Hoard: Challenge 0—4|DMG} table in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If the room contains jewelry, there is a {@chance 50} chance it is in a locked jewelry box requiring {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check to open.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這套物品包含相當於在{@book 城主指南|DMG}中{@table 庫藏寶藏：挑戰等級 0—4|DMG}表格的"寶石或藝術品"欄擲骰兩次所獲得的個人物品。如果房間內有珠寶，則有{@chance 50}機率被鎖在珠寶盒中，需要使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}並透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷檢定才能開啟。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A canoe can be purchased in Port Nyanzaru for 50 gp. It holds up to six Medium creatures and has a maximum speed of 2 mph. It is otherwise identical to a rowboat (see {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一艘獨木舟可以在南扎路港以50金幣的價格購買。它最多可容納六個中型生物，最大速度為每小時2英里。除此之外，它與划艇相同（參見{@i 城主指南}的{@table 擁有一艘船; 空中與水上載具||第五章}）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Characters traveling with beasts of burden and other animals must keep them fed and hydrated as well. See "{@book Food and Water|DMG|5|Food and Water}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for basic requirements based on creature size. Dinosaurs and other creatures native to Chult can forage for food and drink as long as they are in their native habitat.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 攜帶馱獸和其他動物的角色也必須確保它們有充足的食物和水。有關基於生物體型的基本需求，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 糧食與水|DMG|5|糧食與水}"。恐龍以及其他原生於楚爾特（Chult）的生物，只要處於它們的原生棲息地，就可以自行覓食和飲水。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Groak (gold {@creature grung elite warrior|VGM} wearing a {@item circlet of blasting|DMG}) is the love-struck king who seeks to woo the goddess Nangnang. Charismatic but unstable, Groak can swing from friendly to homicidal in the span of a few seconds. Because of this, his people dare not even whisper a harsh word about him. Groak wants to be seen as a visionary and a romantic, and he loves to hear stories of the outside world. However, he threatens anyone who dares to question his inflated self-image. Groak tolerates adventurers as long as they entertain him, generally agree with everything he says, and are willing to aid him in his quest to realize his divine destiny to become Nangnang's consort.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 格羅克（一位戴著{@item 爆裂頭飾|DMG}的{@creature 格龍蛙人精英戰士|VGM}）是痴情的國王，試圖追求女神娜浪。他富有魅力但情緒不穩定，可能在幾秒鐘內從友善轉變為殺人狂。因此，他的臣民甚至不敢低聲說一句關於他的壞話。格羅克希望被視為一個有遠見的浪漫主義者，喜歡聽外界的故事。然而，他會威脅任何膽敢質疑他膨脹自我形象的人。只要冒險者能取悅他、大體上贊同他所說的一切，並願意幫助他實現成為娜浪配偶的神聖命運，格羅克就會容忍他們。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Inside the tower are crude nests and four moldy wooden chests. The chests aren't locked. All together, they hold 2,000 cp, 730 sp, four gemstones (50 gp each), and a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell commune with nature}. One of the chests also contains a cloth-wrapped, wooden mask resembling a stylized tiger's face. This is Azaka's {@item mask of the beast|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8}). If she's with the characters, she claims it immediately.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 塔內有簡陋的巢穴和四個發黴的木箱。這些箱子沒有上鎖。總共，它們包含2000銅幣，730銀幣，四顆寶石（每顆價值50金幣），以及一張{@spell 問道自然}的{@item 法術卷軸}。其中一個箱子還裝有一個布包裹的木製面具，它類似於一個風格化的老虎面孔。這是婀扎卡的{@item 野獸面具|ToA}（見{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}）。如果她與角色們在一起，她會立即認領它。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Three pirate ships use Jahaka Anchorage (map 2.10) as a haven: the {@i Dragonfang}, the {@i Emerald Eye}, and the {@i Stirge}. All three are sailing ships (see {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). See the "{@adventure Pirates of Jahaka Anchorage|ToA|2|Pirates of Jahaka Anchorage}" sidebar for information on the captain and crew of each vessel.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 三艘海盜船將賈哈卡錨地（地圖2.10）作為避風港：{@i 龍牙}、{@i 翡翠之眼}和{@i 蚊蝠}。這三艘船都是帆船（參見{@i 城主指南}中的 {@table 擁有一艘船; 空中與水上載具||第五章}）。關於每艘船的船長和船員資訊，請參見"{@adventure 賈哈卡錨地的海盜|ToA|2|賈哈卡錨地的海盜}"側邊欄。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The calculating Captain {@creature Zaroum Al-Saryak|ToA} (LE male Calishite human {@creature bandit captain}) has a special fondness for gemstones. He wears a coat with glittering gems sewn into it (750 gp) and wears a scimitar with gemstones embedded in the hilt (1,250 gp). His ship, the Emerald Eye, has cabins decorated like rooms in a Calishite pasha's palace. Al-Saryak is fond of chopping off the heads of those who displease him and dangling them from his ship's mermaid figurehead. A long-ago injury cost him his left eye and incised a scar in the form of a large X across his face. The ruined eye socket now holds a magical gem that allows Al-Saryak to discern ghostly pathways leading to treasure. The gem works for no one else. Al-Saryak holds the {@item Sending Stones||sending stone} matched to {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}'s (see "{@area Fort Beluarian|0f2|x}").
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 精明的船長{@creature 扎如姆·艾薩亞克|ToA}（LE男性卡利什特人類{@creature 匪幫隊長}）對寶石情有獨鍾。他穿著一件縫有閃閃發光寶石的外套（750金幣），並佩戴著一把劍柄上嵌有寶石的彎刀（1250金幣）。他的船，翡翠之眼，船艙裝飾得像卡利什特帕夏宮殿裡的房間。Al-Saryak喜歡砍掉那些得罪他的人的頭，並將其懸掛在他的船的美人魚船首上。很久以前的一次傷害使他失去了左眼，並在他的臉上留下了一個大大的X形疤痕。毀壞的眼窩現在裝有一顆魔法寶石，使Al-Saryak能夠辨別通往寶藏的幽靈路徑。這顆寶石對其他人不起作用。Al-Saryak持有與{@creature 莉爾阿·波提爾|ToA}匹配的{@item 短訊石||短訊石}（見"{@area 貝路利安堡|0f2|x}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The smaller statue is actually a {@condition petrified} adventurer named Gowl (NG male Chultan human {@creature scout}). He came to Nangalore in search of riches and was turned to stone by Zalkoré while reaching for the urn. Scratched into the floor next to him are the following words, in Old Omuan: "Once a thief, forever a slave!"
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 較小的雕像實際上是一個名為高爾（守序善良男性楚爾坦人類 {@creature 斥候}）的{@condition 石化}冒險者。他為了尋找財富來到南加洛爾，並在伸手去拿骨灰罈時被扎爾柯蕊變成了石頭。他旁邊的地板上刻著以下古老的奧穆安文字："一次為賊，終身為奴！"

tagShapeMismatches.english: Tzindelor, a female {@creature young red dragon} better known as Tinder, spends most of her time here, dozing atop her treasure hoard. Otherwise, she's out hunting and terrorizing her neighbors. Characters have improved chances to sneak up on her from {@area area 12|1c7|x}, thanks to the loud waterfall there (either they have advantage on {@skill Stealth} checks or Tinder has disadvantage on {@skill Perception} checks, whichever is more appropriate to the situation). The dragon can't be {@status surprised} if kobolds triggered the boulder trap in {@area area 10|1c3|x}, and she can't miss the sound of an ore cart rolling down the tracks or a loud spell going off anywhere in the complex.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: Tzindelor，一隻被稱為Tinder的雌性{@creature 青年紅龍}，大部分時間都在這裡，躺在她的寶藏堆上打盹。否則，她就出去狩獵並恐嚇她的鄰居。角色們從{@area 區域12|1c7|x}悄悄接近她的機會有所提高，這多虧了那裡的大聲瀑布（他們要麼在{@skill 隱匿}檢定上有優勢，要麼Tinder在{@skill 察覺}檢定上處於劣勢，視情況而定）。如果狗頭人觸發了{@area 區域10|1c3|x}的巨石陷阱，龍就不能被{@status 突襲}，她也不能錯過礦車沿著軌道滾動的聲音或在複雜結構中任何地方發出的響亮咒語。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Three covered pits are spaced along the corridor in the positions marked X on the shrine map. Their covers remain locked until the puzzle cube is moved from the pedestal in area 6C. Thereafter, a creature stepping on a pit cover causes it to swing open and falls in unless it succeeds on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. Each pit is 10 feet deep and has a patch of {@hazard green slime} (see {@hazard green slime||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) at the bottom of it.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 沿著走廊在神殿地圖上標記為X的位置分佈著三個隱蔽的陷坑。這些坑蓋會保持鎖定狀態，直到謎題方塊從6C區域的基座上移開。此後，任何生物踏上坑蓋都會使其擺動開啟並墜落其中，除非它成功透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免。每個陷坑深10尺，底部有一片{@hazard 綠軟泥}（參見{@i 城主指南}的{@hazard 綠軟泥||第五章}）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} drops to fewer than half his maximum hit points, he surrenders to his enemies, leads them to his lair (a ruined basement), and offers them stew in a show of friendship. While distributing bowls of stew, he explains that he came to Omu to find a fabled treasure called the Navel of the Moon (see {@area chapter 5|478|x}). He hoped to use its alleged powers to find his lost son, but he has long since given up hope of ever finding it. A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check reveals that the tabaxi has no intention of letting the characters leave his domain alive. He laces the stew with {@item midnight tears||midnight tears (ingested)} (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果{@creature 釘包|ToA}的生命值降至最大生命值的一半以下，他會向敵人投降，帶領他們前往他的巢穴（一個廢墟地下室），並以友誼的名義提供燉菜。在分發燉菜碗時，他解釋說，他來到奧姆是為了尋找傳說中的寶藏——月之臍（見{@area 第五章|478|x}）。他希望利用其傳說中的力量找到他失蹤的兒子，但他早已放棄了找到它的希望。成功的{@dc 15}感知（{@skill 洞悉}）檢定揭示，這個斑貓人無意讓角色們活著離開他的領地。他在燉菜中加入了{@item 午夜之淚||午夜之淚（攝入）}（見{@i 城主指南}第8章的"{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|毒藥}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: During the day, there is a {@chance 50} chance that the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} rests in the amphitheater. At night, this chance decreases to 25 percent. If the beast is out hunting, there is a cumulative {@chance 20} chance per hour of it returning. The {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} is a feathered {@creature tyrannosaurus rex}, with these changes:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 白天，{@creature 翎羽之王|ToA}有{@chance 50}的機率在圓形劇場休息。夜晚時，這個機率會降低至25%。如果這隻野獸外出狩獵，每小時有累計{@chance 20}的機率返回。{@creature 翎羽之王|ToA}是一隻長有羽毛的{@creature 霸王龍}，並具有以下變化：

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} leads the yuan-ti of Omu on a divine mission to usher forth Dendar the Night Serpent and trigger the end of the world (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for more information on {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and his evil plans). His version of the apocalypse is not imminent, since {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} is distracted with fears of his own mortality. He has fallen victim to the death curse and is growing weaker by the day, and neither he nor his yuan-ti priests have been able to ascertain the cause or find a remedy. As {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s power wanes, his rivals are preparing to dispose of him and continue their holy mission.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 拉茲·納斯|ToA}領導著歐姆的蛇人執行一項神聖使命，旨在召喚夜蛇丹達爾並引發世界末日（更多關於{@creature 拉茲·納斯|ToA}及其邪惡計劃的資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。他的末日預言尚未迫在眉睫，因為{@creature 拉茲·納斯|ToA}正因對自己死亡恐懼而分心。他已成為死亡詛咒的受害者，日漸衰弱，而他和他的蛇人祭司們都無法確定其原因或找到解救之法。隨著{@creature 拉茲·納斯|ToA}力量的減弱，他的對手們正準備好除掉他，繼續他們的神聖使命。

tagShapeMismatches.english: 1 {@creature yuan-ti abomination} arriving at the temple to challenge {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s leadership. If {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} is alive, she uses her influence to arrange a showdown between {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and the abomination in the fane ({@area area 9|2ca|x}). If {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} is {@condition incapacitated} or dead, the abomination bullies its way to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s throne room ({@area area 11|2da|x}), where it is killed.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 1 {@creature 憎惡蛇人} 到達神廟挑戰{@creature 拉茲·納斯|ToA}的領導地位。如果{@creature 芬薩札|ToA}還活著，她會利用她的影響力安排在神廟（{@area 區域9|2ca|x}）中{@creature 拉茲·納斯|ToA}和這個怪物之間的決鬥。如果{@creature 芬薩札|ToA}被{@condition 失能}或死亡，這個怪物強行闖入{@creature 拉茲·納斯|ToA}的王座室（{@area 區域11|2da|x}），在那裡它被殺死。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Prisoners are forced to wear manacles on their wrists and shackles on their ankles. The manacles impose disadvantage on ability checks made to climb or swim. The shackles reduce a prisoner's walking speed by half and impose disadvantage on ability checks made to jump. {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} (see {@area area 5|2ba|x}) carries the keys for these bindings. See "{@book Adventuring Gear|PHB|5|Adventuring Gear}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Player's Handbook} for rules on breaking, escaping, and unlocking manacles (and shackles).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 囚犯被迫在手腕上戴上手銬，腳踝上戴上腳鐐。手銬會使攀爬或游泳的技能檢定處於劣勢。腳鐐會使囚犯的行走速度減半，並且跳躍的技能檢定處於劣勢。{@creature 芬薩札|ToA}（見{@area 區域5|2ba|x}）持有這些束縛的鑰匙。有關破壞、逃脫和開啟手銬（和腳鐐）的規則，請參見《{@i 玩家手冊}》第5章中的"{@book 冒險用品|PHB|5|冒險用品}"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Characters who search through the poisons can loot twenty doses of {@item serpent venom|DMG}, five doses of {@item essence of ether|DMG}, and five doses of torpor (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 搜尋毒藥的玩家可以掠奪二十劑{@item 蛇毒|DMG}、五劑{@item 乙醚精|DMG}和五劑麻痺毒藥（詳見{@i 城主指南}第八章"{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|毒藥}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When the characters arrive, a pair of rowboats are pulled up on the shore near the tunnel to {@area area 23|303|x} (see {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for more information on rowboats). A cowbell dangles from a hook at the prow of each boat. Ringing either bell summons the hydra in {@area area 21|2ff|x}, which arrives in {@dice 1d6} rounds.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當角色們到達時，一對划艇被拉到了通往{@area 區域23|303|x}的隧道附近的岸邊（有關划艇的更多資訊，請參見{@i 城主指南}中的{@table 擁有一艘船; 空中與水上載具||第五章}）。每艘船的船頭掛鉤上懸掛著一個牛鈴。敲擊任何一個鈴鐺都會召喚{@area 區域21|2ff|x}中的九頭蛇，它將在{@dice 1d6}輪內到達。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A patch of {@hazard green slime} (see {@hazard green slime||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) clings to the ceiling above the entrance and drops on the first creature that passes underneath.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一塊{@hazard 綠軟泥}（參見{@i 城主指南}的{@hazard 綠軟泥||第五章}）附著在入口上方的天花板上，會落在第一個從下方經過的生物身上。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A patch of {@hazard yellow mold} (see {@hazard yellow mold||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) covers the skeletal corpse. If a creature touches the mold, it ejects a cloud of deadly spores.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一簇{@hazard 黃黴菌}（參見{@i 城主指南}的{@hazard 黃黴菌||第五章}）覆蓋在骸骨上。若有生物觸碰黴菌，它會噴出致命的孢子云。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The tunnel leading to the tomb's true entrance ({@area area 4|334|x}) is obscured by vegetation and cannot be detected unless the characters search for it. However, any character who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check around the areas of the false entrance ({@area area 2|32f|x}) or the open gallery ({@area area 3|332|x}) notices something more:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 通往墓室真正入口的隧道（{@area 區域4|334|x}）被植被遮蔽，除非角色進行搜尋，否則無法被發現。然而，任何在假入口（{@area 區域2|32f|x}）或開放畫廊（{@area 區域3|332|x}）附近成功透過{@dc 10}感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定的角色會注意到更多：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Any creature wearing one of the wights' papier-mâché masks can push aside the lid of the sarcophagus with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. To all other creatures, the lid is magically locked and cannot be opened without a {@spell knock} spell or a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 任何戴著其中一個屍鬼的紙漿面具的生物，可以透過一次成功的{@dc 13}力量（{@skill 運動}）檢定推開石棺的蓋子。對於其他所有生物而言，棺蓋被魔法鎖住，除非使用{@spell 敲擊術}法術，或由一名角色使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定，否則無法開啟。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the check fails, the demon skull bites down on the {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and destroys them. If the check fails by 5 or more, the magical trap teleports the character making the check inside the locked chest, whereupon the character is {@condition restrained}. The chains holding the chest then release it into the water, where it sinks to the bottom of the pool. Even if the chest is removed from the water, a character trapped within runs out of air after 5 rounds (see "{@book Suffocating|PHB|8|Suffocating}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Player's Handbook}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 若檢定失敗，惡魔頭骨會咬住{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}並將其摧毀。若檢定失敗且差值達到5或更高，魔法陷阱會將進行檢定的角色傳送到上鎖的寶箱內部，該角色將陷入{@condition 束縛}狀態。固定寶箱的鎖鏈隨後會將其釋放入水，沉至池底。即使寶箱被移出水面，受困角色仍會在5輪後窒息（參見{@i 玩家手冊}第8章中的"{@book 窒息|PHB|8|窒息}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The dao could become a thorn in the characters' side or a difficult ally. Her ignorance of the tomb's defenses confines her to {@area area 57|47d|x} if she casts {@spell plane shift}. If she escapes from {@area area 57|47d|x}, she expects the characters to help her find a safe way out of the tomb. When she learns of the trickster gods, Keshma encourages the characters to seek them out and use them to defeat {@creature Acererak|ToA}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 土巨靈可能會成為角色們的棘手問題或一個難以相處的盟友。她對墓穴防禦的無知限制了她如果施放{@spell 位面轉移}法術時只能到達{@area 區域57|47d|x}區域。如果她從{@area 區域57|47d|x}逃脫，她期望角色們幫助她找到一個安全離開墓穴的路徑。當她瞭解到詭計之神時，Keshma鼓勵角色們尋找他們，並利用他們來擊敗{@creature 阿瑟瑞克|ToA}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Withers|ToA} has enough equipment on his desk to assemble a scholar's pack. A {@item manual of golems} (clay) lies open on his desk next to a spellbook containing all the spells he has prepared. On the inside back cover of the spellbook is what appears to be a name: Khomara Blackfire. "Khomara" and "Blackfire" are actually the command words for the {@item mirror of life trapping} in {@area area 50|44c|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}的桌上有足夠的裝備，可湊成一套學者套組。一本{@item manual of golems||魔像手冊}（黏土）攤在桌上，旁邊的法術書記載了他準備的所有法術。法術書封底內側寫著看似姓名的字樣：Khomara Blackfire。其實「Khomara」與「Blackfire」是{@area 區域50|44c|x}那面{@item mirror of life trapping||攝心鏡}的口令。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Map 5.3 shows this level of the dungeon, which an {@condition invisible} beholder named Belchorzh the Unseen (see {@area area 44|414|x}) claims as its home. It doesn't have access to lair actions and regional effects; instead, it has infected its home with weird alien growth.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 地圖5.3顯示了這個地牢的這一層次，一個名為Belchorzh the Unseen（不見的Belchorzh，見{@area 區域44|414|x}）的{@condition 隱形}巨眼獸聲稱這裡是它的家。它沒有巢穴動作和區域效果的使用權；相反，它用奇異的外星生長物感染了它的家園。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The clay golem has orders to attack any creature that it sees and can reach. If the golem is destroyed, {@creature Withers|ToA} uses his {@item manual of golems} in {@area area 28|3aa|x} to create a new one after 30 days.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 粘土魔像接到命令，攻擊它看到並能夠觸及的任何生物。如果魔像被摧毀，{@creature 威瑟斯|ToA}會使用他在{@area 區域28|3aa|x}中的{@item 魔像手冊}在30天后製造一個新的。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The water fills the cell at a rate of 1 foot per round, taking 10 rounds to fill the room. If the candle is left in its sconce, the rising water extinguishes it on the fourth round. Trying to stuff or block the holes doesn't stop the water from pouring in. Because of the cell's {@spell antimagic field}, spells and magic items that enable characters to breathe underwater don't function here. Any character who runs out of air begins to suffocate (see "{@book The Environment|PHB|8|The Environment}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Player's Handbook}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 水以每輪1尺的速度填滿牢房，10輪後房間會被完全填滿。如果蠟燭留在燭臺上，上升的水將在第四輪將其熄滅。試圖堵塞或阻擋孔洞並不能阻止水湧入。由於牢房內的{@spell 反魔法場}，使角色能夠在水下呼吸的法術和魔法物品在此處無法生效。任何空氣耗盡的角色將開始窒息（參見{@i 玩家手冊}第8章中的"{@book 環境|PHB|8|環境}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Any creature that requires air to breathe immediately begins to suffocate unless it took the precaution of holding its breath before teleporting here (see "{@book The Environment|PHB|8|The Environment}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Player's Handbook}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 任何需要空氣呼吸的生物會立即開始窒息，除非它在傳送到這裡之前採取了屏息的預防措施（參見{@i 玩家手冊}第8章中的"{@book 環境|PHB|8|環境}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The lock on the chest can be picked with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. Within the chest is an {@condition invisible} key, 3 inches long and made of brass. Any character who manually searches inside the chest feels the key, which unlocks the clock in {@area area 56|478|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 箱子的鎖可以透過使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次成功的{@dc 10}敏捷檢定撬開。箱內有一把{@condition 隱形}的鑰匙，3吋長，由黃銅製成。任何手動搜尋箱內的角色都能摸到這把鑰匙，它可以解鎖{@area 區域56|478|x}的時鐘。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of solid granite balances within a secret compartment at the top of the stairs. Finding the compartment requires that a character search the tunnel ceiling and succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The hatch can be jammed with an iron spike or with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個直徑5尺的實心花崗巖球體平衡地放置在樓梯頂部的暗格中。發現該暗格需要角色搜尋隧道頂部並透過一次{@dc 15}感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定。可以用鐵釘卡住艙口，或透過使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定。

tagShapeMismatches.english: An invisible locked metal door shields the compartment containing the clock's pendulum. The invisibility effect on the door can't be dispelled, but the keyhole can be located by touch. The invisible key from the treasure chest in area 54A opens the lock, as does a {@spell knock} spell. To pick the lock, a character must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. If the character thinks to blow powdered chalk, dust, or a similar substance into the lock to highlight its gears, the check is made with advantage.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一扇隱形的上鎖金屬門保護著時鐘擺輪的隔間。門上的隱形效果無法被解除，但可以透過觸控找到鑰匙孔。來自54A區域寶箱中的隱形鑰匙可以開啟鎖，{@spell 敲擊術}法術同樣有效。要撬開鎖，角色必須使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次{@dc 20}的敏捷檢定。如果角色想到向鎖內吹入粉筆灰、灰塵或類似物質以突出其齒輪，則該檢定具有優勢。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The lever's locking mechanism can be released with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. If released, the lever automatically shifts to the up position, shutting the valves in the pipes and stopping the flow of slime. The lever can be torn from the console with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, which has the same effect.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 槓桿的鎖定機制可以透過角色使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來解除。如果解除成功，槓桿會自動切換到上升位置，關閉管道中的閥門並停止粘液流動。也可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill 運動}）檢定將槓桿從控制檯上扯下，效果相同。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Hidden behind a bas-relief depicting a crocodile-headed humanoid holding up a trapezoidal chest, a crawlway leads to area 62D. Close inspection of the relief reveals that the chest's keyhole is real. The jade key found in {@area area 53|459|x} can be used to unlock the relief and swing it open, revealing the crawlway. The lock can also be picked with a successful {@dc 21} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. But if the check fails by 5 or more, the secret door in the west wall slides open to release the stone juggernaut (see "Napaka Awakens" in area 62D).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 隱藏在一幅描繪鱷魚頭人形生物託舉梯形箱子的淺浮雕後方，一條爬行通道通向區域62D。仔細觀察浮雕會發現箱子的鑰匙孔是真實的。在{@area 區域53|459|x}找到的翡翠鑰匙可用於解鎖浮雕並使其擺動開啟，露出爬行通道。鎖也可以透過角色使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次成功的{@dc 21}敏捷檢定來撬開。但如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，西牆的密門會滑開釋放出岩石戰車（參見區域62D的"納帕卡甦醒"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The locked hatch is a Large object with AC 11, 25 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. As long as the outer rings and orbs aren't in motion, the hatch can be forced open with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, or opened with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made by character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 上鎖的艙口是一個大型物體，具有AC 11、25點生命值，並且免疫毒素和心靈傷害。只要外環和球體沒有移動，艙口可以透過成功的{@dc 20}力量（{@skill 運動}）檢定強行開啟，或者由角色使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定來開啟。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA} (see {@area area 74|4eb|x}) carries the key to the padlock, which can otherwise be unlocked with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. The lock can also be broken off easily enough.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 針線先生|ToA}（參見{@area 區域74|4eb|x}）攜帶著掛鎖的鑰匙，否則可以透過使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定解鎖。該鎖也可以被輕易砸開。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The compartment can also be opened with a {@spell knock} spell, or with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. Opening the compartment in either manner triggers the trap (see "Spider Fan Trap" below).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個隔間也可以用{@spell 敲擊術}法術開啟，或者由一名角色使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定來開啟。以任一方式開啟隔間都會觸發陷阱（見下方的"蜘蛛扇陷阱"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The night hag Widow Groat (see {@area area 71|4d8|x}) carries the keys to the nothics' shackles, which can also be picked with a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, or sundered with a good, hard weapon strike.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 夜鬼婆寡婦格羅特（見{@area 區域71|4d8|x}）攜帶著諾提枷鎖的鑰匙，這些枷鎖也可以透過角色使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}成功透過{@dc 13}敏捷檢定撬開，或者用強力武器打擊破壞。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The old man sleeping in the chair is an {@creature arcanaloth} under the effect of its {@spell alter self} spell. The fiend has one of the library's spellbooks lying open on its lap and pretends to be asleep. If approached, the man appears to wake and asks, "Why do you disturb me?" The creature won't reveal its true name, instead referring to itself as "Mr. Fox." The arcanaloth is bound to the library by {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s magic and can't leave, nor can it allow any of the library's books or scrolls to be removed.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 坐在椅子上睡覺的老人是一只受到其{@spell 變身術}法術影響的{@creature 奧法羅斯魔}。這個惡魔的腿上攤開著圖書館的一本法術書，假裝在睡覺。如果有人接近，這個人似乎會醒來並問："你為什麼打擾我？"這個生物不會透露它的真實名字，而是自稱為"狐狸先生"。奧法羅斯魔被{@creature 阿瑟瑞克|ToA}的魔法束縛在圖書館裡，不能離開，也不能允許圖書館的任何書籍或卷軸被拿走。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Characters who survive the Tomb of the Nine Gods won't know the fate of {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA} until they return to Port Nyanzaru, use a spell such as {@spell scrying} to spy on her, or reach out to her with a {@spell sending} spell or similar magic. If the characters destroy the Soulmonger and Syndra is still alive, priests quickly restore her to full health, and the characters can collect their promised reward. If Syndra dies but her soul is saved before the atropal devours it, she is raised from the dead within a tenday of the Soulmonger's destruction and honors her agreement with the party. In the event that Syndra dies and her soul is devoured, her body lies in state pending a funeral and proper burial.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 倖存於九神之墓的角色們在返回南扎路港、使用如{@spell 探知術}法術監視她，或透過{@spell 短訊術}法術或類似魔法與她聯絡之前，不會知道{@creature 辛德拉·席爾瓦因|ToA}的命運。如果角色們摧毀了靈魂收割者而辛德拉還活著，祭司們會迅速恢復她的健康，角色們可以領取他們承諾的獎勵。如果辛德拉死了，但她的靈魂在萎縮者吞噬之前被救出，她會在靈魂收割者被摧毀後的十天內復活，並履行她與隊伍的協議。如果辛德拉死了，她的靈魂被吞噬，她的遺體將等待葬禮和適當的安葬。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Alarm horns declare that undead are attacking Malar's Throat. Mercenaries keep the monsters out of the city proper, but people are trapped in the temple of Tymora and besieged by {@dice 2d6} {@creature zombie||zombies} and {@dice 2d6} {@creature skeleton||skeletons} led by a {@creature ghoul}. If the characters defeat the undead, the temple rewards them with 5 gallons of tej and a {@item potion of healing}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 警報號角宣告不死生物正在攻擊瑪拉之喉。僱傭兵阻止怪物進入城市中心，但人們被困在泰摩拉的神殿中，並遭到由一隻{@creature 食屍鬼}帶領的{@dice 2d6}只{@creature 喪屍||喪屍們}和{@dice 2d6}只{@creature 骷髏||骷髏們}圍攻。如果角色們擊敗了不死生物，神殿將獎勵他們5加侖的蜂蜜酒和一瓶{@item 治療藥水}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: An excellent {@item lock|PHB} (50 gp) that requires a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check to pick using {@item thieves' tools|PHB} (the lock's key is missing)
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一把優質的{@item 鎖|PHB}（50金幣），需要使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}並透過一次{@dc 20}敏捷檢定才能撬開（該鎖的鑰匙已丟失）

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@dice d20|Roll a die}. On an even result, the party encounters a single {@creature flying snake}. On an odd result, the characters encounter {@dice 2d6} {@creature flying snake||flying snakes}. These snakes attack only when threatened. A {@creature flying snake} that is successfully {@condition grappled} can be stuffed in a sack or other soft container. After 1 hour of confinement, the snake settles down. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|PHB}) check can remove a calm snake from the container without causing it to attack or fly away.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@dice d20|擲骰子}。若結果為偶數，隊伍會遇到一隻{@creature 飛蛇}。若結果為奇數，角色們會遇到{@dice 2d6}只{@creature 飛蛇||飛蛇}。這些蛇只會在受到威脅時攻擊。成功{@condition 受擒}的{@creature 飛蛇}可被裝入麻袋或其他柔軟容器中。經過1小時的拘禁後，蛇會安靜下來。成功透過{@dc 13}感知（{@skill 馴獸|PHB}）檢定的角色可以從容器中取出平靜的蛇，而不會導致其攻擊或飛走。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Before it rises out of the water, make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) check for the {@creature giant crocodile}. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score less than the check result is {@status surprised} when the monstrous creature attacks.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在它從水中躍出之前，為{@creature 巨鱷}進行一次敏捷（{@skill 隱匿|PHB}）檢定。任何被動感知（{@skill 察覺|PHB}）數值低於檢定結果的角色，在這頭龐然大物發動攻擊時會陷入{@status 突襲}狀態。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 11 or higher spots {@dice 1d3} {@creature giant scorpion||giant scorpions} moments before they emerge from hiding and attack. At the end of the encounter, any character damaged by a giant scorpion must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected with {@disease shivering sickness|ToA} (see {@i "Diseases"}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 任何被動感知（{@skill 察覺|PHB}）達到11或更高的角色會在{@creature 巨蠍||巨蠍}從藏身處現身並發動攻擊前發現{@dice 1d3}只。遭遇結束後，任何被巨蠍傷害的角色必須成功透過{@dc 11}體質豁免，否則會感染{@disease 寒顫病|ToA}（參見{@i "疾病"}章節）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Giant spider webs are easily concealed in Chult's dense jungles and swamps. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 13 or higher spots the webs in time to alert the other characters to an encounter with {@dice 1d6} {@creature giant spider||giant spiders}. Otherwise, the spiders attack with {@status surprised||surprise} when the lead party member blunders into a sticky web and becomes {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 12}). Hundreds of baby giant spiders crawl through the webs, but they are harmless.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在楚爾特茂密的叢林和沼澤中，巨型蜘蛛網很容易被隱藏。任何被動感知（{@skill 察覺|PHB}）達到13或更高的角色都能及時發現這些蛛網，警告其他同伴即將遭遇{@dice 1d6}只{@creature 巨蜘蛛||巨蜘蛛}。否則當領隊成員誤入粘性蛛網並{@condition 受擒}時（逃脫{@dc 12}），蜘蛛們將獲得{@status 突襲||驚訝}優勢發起攻擊。數百隻幼年巨型蜘蛛在蛛網中爬行，但它們並無威脅。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Moving through the city or palace ruins are {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature kobold||kobolds} led by a {@creature kobold inventor|VGM}. Characters with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 12 or higher spot the kobolds, which flee if approached or attacked. The kobolds serve the kobold scale sorcerer Kakarol (see chapter 3). They might be on their way to one of the city's shrines to reset its traps, or they might be returning to their lair with a recently discovered treasure. Roll once on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what, if anything, the kobolds found.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在城市或宮殿廢墟中穿行時，會遇到由{@creature 狗頭人發明家|VGM}帶領的{@dice 1d4 + 1}只{@creature 狗頭人||狗頭人}。被動感知（{@skill 察覺|PHB}）達到12或更高的角色會發現這些狗頭人，它們在被接近或攻擊時會逃跑。這些狗頭人為狗頭人鱗甲術士卡卡洛爾效力（見第3章）。它們可能正前往城市中的某個神殿重置陷阱，或者帶著新發現的寶物返回巢穴。在{@table 獨眼巨人; 寶藏掉落|ToA|寶藏掉落}表上擲一次骰，以確定狗頭人發現了什麼（如果有的話）。

numericDifferences.english: Chris Perkins, May 2017
numericDifferences.localized: 克里斯·珀金斯，2017年5月

numericDifferences.english: On days that receive heavy rain, there's a {@chance 25} chance of a full-blown tropical storm featuring sheets of rain, high wind, lightning, tall waves at sea, and immense surf along the coast. Guides who know the conditions in Chult recommend hunkering down and staying put on these days. Travel by river is impossible (canoes are swamped by waves within 15 minutes of launching). If characters insist on traveling by foot, every character gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} automatically and must make a successful {@dc 10} Constitution check or gain another. Skill checks to avoid becoming lost are made with disadvantage on storm days.
numericDifferences.localized: 在遭遇暴雨的日子裡，有{@chance 25}機率形成完全發展的熱帶風暴，伴隨傾盆大雨、狂風、閃電、海上的巨浪以及沿岸的巨大浪湧。熟悉瓊達爾地區情況的嚮導建議在這些日子裡就地躲避。河道旅行將無法進行（獨木舟在出發後15分鐘內就會被浪湧淹沒）。如果角色堅持徒步旅行，每個角色將自動獲得1層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態，並且必須成功透過{@dc 10}體質檢定，否則再獲得1層。在暴風雨天氣中，避免迷路的技能檢定將具有劣勢。

numericDifferences.english: Goldenthrone is the best place to meet any of the merchant princes without an appointment. They rarely meet with visitors who show up unannounced at their homes. During the day, each merchant prince has a 1-in-6 chance to be at Goldenthrone, accompanied by a retinue of aides and guards. Characters must wait {@dice 1d3} hours before being given an audience. In fact, the merchant princes have few day-to-day responsibilities when it comes to running Port Nyanzaru, so unless a meeting is being held to discuss city business, the delay is just a tactic to underscore who's in charge. If the characters have interesting news, they're likely to obtain an audience and to be given as much of the merchant's time as they need.
numericDifferences.localized: 金座是與任何商人王子會面而無需預約的最佳地點。他們很少與未經宣佈就出現在他們家中的訪客見面。在白天，每個商人王子有六分之一的機會在金座，伴隨著助手和守衛的隨行。角色必須等待{@dice 1d3}小時才能被接見。實際上，商人王子在管理南扎路港的日常事務中幾乎沒有責任，所以除非正在舉行討論城市事務的會議，否則這種延遲只是一種強調誰是負責人的策略。如果角色有有趣的訊息，他們很可能會獲得接見，並被給予他們需要的商人的時間。

numericDifferences.english: Foot bridges of rope and bamboo hang above the ravine. Some of them are 200 feet long or longer and sway a hundred feet above ground, terrifying the faint of heart. Skilled thieves have been known to drop hooks on thin lines from the bridges and "fish" purses right off victims' belts.
numericDifferences.localized: 繩索和竹製的足橋懸掛在峽谷上方。有些橋長達200尺甚至更長，它們在地面上方100尺處搖擺，令膽小的人感到恐懼。有技巧的小偷被知道會從橋上放下細線上的鉤子，直接從受害者的腰帶上"釣魚"般地取走錢包。

numericDifferences.english: If characters move at a fast pace, the easiest way to deal with their progress is to roll a {@dice d4}. On a roll of 3 or 4, they advance 1 additional hex that day. Characters moving at a fast pace take a–5 penalty to their passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) scores, making them more likely to miss clues and walk into ambushes.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色以快速步伐前進，處理他們進展的最簡單方式是擲一個{@dice d4}。如果擲出3或4，他們那天額外前進一個六邊形。以快速步伐移動的角色對他們的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分有-5的懲罰，這使他們更有可能錯過線索並走進伏擊。

numericDifferences.english: If characters set a slow pace, roll a {@dice d4}. On a roll of 1 or 2, they advance 1 fewer hex that day (in other words, 1 hex by canoe or none by foot). On any other result, their caution is rewarded, and they travel the same distance as a group moving at a normal pace. Characters moving at a slow pace can move stealthily. As long as they're not in the open, they can try to surprise or sneak by other creatures they encounter.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色們保持緩慢的步伐，擲一個{@dice d4}。如果是1或2，那天他們少前進一個六邊形（換句話說，乘獨木舟前進1個六邊形或步行不前進）。如果是其他結果，他們的謹慎會得到回報，他們可以像正常速度移動的團隊一樣行進相同的距離。以慢速移動的角色可以悄無聲息地移動。只要他們不在開闊地帶，他們就可以嘗試突襲或悄悄繞過他們遇到的其他生物。

numericDifferences.english: At the start of each new travel day, the DM makes a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check on behalf of the navigator. The result of the check determines whether or not the party becomes lost over the course of the day. The DC of the check is based on the day's most common terrain: {@dc 10} for coasts and lakes, or {@dc 15} for jungles, mountains, rivers, swamps, and wastelands. Apply a +5 bonus to the check if the group sets a slow pace for the day, or a–5 penalty if the group is moving at a fast pace. It's possible to get lost on a river by following a tributary instead of the main branch.
numericDifferences.localized: 在每個新的旅行日開始時，DM 代表導航員進行一次感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。檢定的結果決定了團隊在當天是否會迷路。檢定的DC基於當天最常見的地形：海岸和湖泊為 {@dc 10}，叢林、山脈、河流、沼澤和荒地為 {@dc 15}。如果團隊當天以慢速度行進，則在檢定上獲得+5加值；如果以快速度行進，則施加-5減值。如果在河流上跟隨支流而非主流，也有可能迷路。

numericDifferences.english: Characters traveling with beasts of burden and other animals must keep them fed and hydrated as well. See "{@book Food and Water|DMG|5|Food and Water}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for basic requirements based on creature size. Dinosaurs and other creatures native to Chult can forage for food and drink as long as they are in their native habitat.
numericDifferences.localized: 攜帶馱獸和其他動物的角色也必須確保它們有充足的食物和水。有關基於生物體型的基本需求，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 糧食與水|DMG|5|Food and Water}"。恐龍以及其他原生於楚爾特（Chult）的生物，只要處於它們的原生棲息地，就可以自行覓食和飲水。

numericDifferences.english: Minuscule parasites known as throat leeches infect the water in Chult's forests, swamps, and rivers. Any giant or humanoid that swallows tainted water must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be infested with throat leeches. Immediate symptoms include throat inflammation and shortness of breath. After {@dice 1d6} hours, the infected character gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} that can't be removed (except as described below) until the disease is cured. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must repeat the saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's {@condition exhaustion} increases by 1 level; on a successful save, the creature's {@condition exhaustion} decreases by 1 level. If a successful saving throw reduces the infected creature's level of {@condition exhaustion} below 1, the creature recovers from the disease.
numericDifferences.localized: 被稱為咽喉水蛭的微小寄生蟲會感染楚爾特叢林、沼澤和河流中的水源。任何喝下了受汙染的水的巨人或類人生物必須進行一次 {@dc 12} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則感染咽喉水蛭。症狀立即發作，包括喉嚨發炎和呼吸急促。{@dice 1d6} 小時後，受感染角色提升 1 級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，持續至該疾病被治癒為止（下列情況除外）。每次長休結束時，受感染生物必須重骰該豁免。豁免失敗則該生物的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}增加 1 級；豁免成功則該生物的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}降低 1 級。如果一次成功的豁免使受感染生物的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}降低至 0，則該生物從該疾病中恢復。

numericDifferences.english: Templars from the Order of the Gauntlet removed everything of value from these tents when they came to inspect the scene of the disaster. A character who pokes around in one of these tents has a 1-in-6 chance of stirring up a {@creature poisonous snake}.
numericDifferences.localized: 鐵手套教團的聖殿騎士前來勘查災難現場時，已帶走這些帳篷裡所有值錢的物品。角色在其中一頂帳篷裡翻找時，有六分之一的機率驚動一條{@creature poisonous snake||毒蛇}。

numericDifferences.english: The templars kept swine in this pen for food. They're long gone, but a fledgling {@creature axe beak} with 6 hit points and no effective attacks (0 XP) has gotten itself trapped inside the enclosure. If characters leave it alone or set it loose, it causes no problems. If they attack or harass the bird, its squawks attract five adult {@creature Axe Beak||axe beaks}, which crash out of the jungle 2 rounds later, ready to fight whatever they meet.
numericDifferences.localized: 聖騎士們在這個圍欄裡飼養豬作為食物。豬早已不見了，但一隻幼小的{@creature axe beak||斧嘴鳥}，有6點生命值且沒有有效的攻擊（0經驗值）被困在了圍欄裡。如果角色們不打擾它或放它自由，它不會帶來任何問題。如果他們攻擊或騷擾這隻鳥，它的尖叫聲會吸引五隻成年的{@creature Axe Beak||斧嘴鳥}，在兩輪後從叢林中衝出來，準備攻擊它們遇到的任何東西。

numericDifferences.english: The rope-and-wood ladders mounted to the spire are ancient and crumbling. Each character who ascends a ladder to the next higher level (from the ground to level 1, from level 1 to level 2, and so on) must make a {@dc 8} Dexterity ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the check succeeds, the character reaches the next level safely without damaging the fragile ladder. If the check fails, a few rungs of the ladder are damaged and the DC increases by 2 for everyone following behind the climber. If the check fails by 5 or more, the ladder is damaged and the climber falls—quite possibly to his or her death, unless precautions were taken (roping characters together, for example).
numericDifferences.localized: 安裝在尖塔上的繩木梯古老且搖搖欲墜。每個角色從地面到第一層、從第一層到第二層（以此類推）攀爬梯子時，都必須進行一次{@dc 8}敏捷（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色安全到達下一層且不會損壞脆弱的梯子。如果檢定失敗，梯子的幾級橫檔會損壞，後續攀爬者的DC會增加2。如果檢定失敗超過5點或更多，梯子會損壞，攀爬者會墜落——如果沒有采取預防措施（例如用繩子將角色綁在一起），很可能會導致死亡。

numericDifferences.english: Level 1. Abandoned Cave
numericDifferences.localized: 第一層。廢棄的洞穴

numericDifferences.english: Reaching Level 2
numericDifferences.localized: 到達第二層

numericDifferences.english: Level 2. Stirge Cave
numericDifferences.localized: 第二層。吸血蝙蝠洞

numericDifferences.english: Reaching Level 3
numericDifferences.localized: 到達第三層

numericDifferences.english: Clinging to the west face of the spire is a ledge, above which is a ladder leading up to level 3. Whenever a character crosses the ledge, roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 1, a sudden gust of wind threatens to blow the character off the ledge. The character must make a {@dc 9} Dexterity saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the character falls to the base of the spire unless he or she is secured by ropes.
numericDifferences.localized: 在尖塔的西側表面有一個突出的巖架，上方是一個通向第三層的梯子。每當一個角色穿過巖架時，擲一個{@dice d6}。若擲出1，一陣突如其來的強風可能將角色吹下巖架。角色必須進行一個{@dc 9}的敏捷豁免檢定。若豁免失敗，角色將墜落到尖塔的底部，除非他或她被繩索固定住。

numericDifferences.english: Level 3. Pterafolk Nest
numericDifferences.localized: 第三層。翼手獸的巢穴

numericDifferences.english: Reaching Level 4
numericDifferences.localized: 到達第四層

numericDifferences.english: Level 4. Pinnacle
numericDifferences.localized: 第四層。尖頂

numericDifferences.english: Pterafolk never use the chimney between level 3 and level 4 other than to occasionally drop food to a prisoner. The top of the chimney is surrounded by rocks and low bushes, providing enough concealment for three Medium creatures. Hiding from the pterafolk requires a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check, with advantage at nighttime or when it's raining.
numericDifferences.localized: 翼手獸在第三層和第四層之間從不使用煙囪，除了偶爾向囚犯投遞食物。煙囪頂部被岩石和低矮的灌木叢包圍，為三個中型生物提供了足夠的隱蔽。躲避翼手獸需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 12} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，在夜間或下雨時具有優勢。

numericDifferences.english: The water flowing down the main concourse is only 1 foot deep, and the current isn't particularly strong. Originally, the six side branches off the main avenue were roofed over, but two of the roofs have caved in, and three others are partially collapsed. Debris chokes the walkways where the tunnel roofs fell. The roofs that remain intact have vines and roots hanging down from them. The covered tunnels are only 4 feet high and contain a foot of water.
numericDifferences.localized: 流經主大道的水只有1尺深，水流並不特別強。最初，主大道的六條側支道都有屋頂覆蓋，但其中兩個屋頂已經坍塌，另外三個部分倒塌。隧道屋頂坍塌的地方堆滿了碎片，阻塞了走道。仍然完好的屋頂上掛著藤蔓和樹根。有蓋的隧道只有4尺高，裡面積有1尺深的水。

numericDifferences.english: Face 2 (upper west) has a condescending expression. The message above it reads, "Worshiped by her people and by Thiru-taya, who loves BETRAYED her." (The word "loves" has been chipped away, and the word "BETRAYED" is scratched into the stone above it.)
numericDifferences.localized: 第二面（上西）帶著一種輕蔑的表情。它上面的資訊寫道："被她的人民和愛她的提魯-塔亞崇拜，但她被背叛了。"（"愛"這個詞被鑿掉了，在它上面的石頭上刻著"背叛"。）

numericDifferences.english: Face 3 (upper east) has a stern expression. The message above it reads, "In this, the tenth year of her reign, may she govern forever in splendor."
numericDifferences.localized: 第三尊面孔（上東）表情嚴肅。其上方的資訊寫著："在她統治的第十年，願她永遠在輝煌中治理。"

numericDifferences.english: A wide sinkhole yawns before you, the earth around it littered with goblin bones. The opening is 90 feet across and roughly circular, and the stone walls are nearly vertical. Thirty feet down, the sinkhole is filled with murky green water. Hundreds of frogs hop from one floating plant to another.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個寬闊的天坑在你面前張開，周圍的地面上散落著地精的骨頭。洞口寬90尺，大致呈圓形，石壁幾乎垂直。30尺深的地方，天坑裡充滿了渾濁的綠色水。數百隻青蛙從一個漂浮的植物跳到另一個。

numericDifferences.english: The massive rib cage and fine wing bones of a dragon rise above the murk. Vines, moss, and lichen hang from the bones. Judging from how much of the skeleton is exposed, the water can't be more than 3 or 4 feet deep.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個龍的巨大肋骨架和精緻的翼骨在泥濘中顯現出來。藤蔓、苔蘚和地衣懸掛在骨骼上。從暴露出的骨架部分判斷，水深最多也就三四尺。

numericDifferences.english: The steps from the ground to level 1 of the ziggurat are 50 feet long and rise 30 feet. A tangle of roots, vines, and creepers covers the steps. Characters can climb the first 10 feet as {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. After 10 feet, they begin getting scratched by thorns. If they continue, they take 1 slashing damage per foot climbed. After 20 feet, that increases to 2 slashing damage per foot. The thorns regrow as quickly as they're slashed, burned, or destroyed, and they can't be parted by magic or by abilities. No damage is incurred for moving down the steps.
numericDifferences.localized: 從地面到金字形神塔第一層的臺階長50尺，高30尺。臺階上覆蓋著糾結的樹根、藤蔓和攀緣植物。角色們可以將最初的10尺視為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}來攀爬。超過10尺後，他們開始被荊棘揮砍。如果他們繼續攀爬，每爬升一尺會遭受1點揮砍傷害。超過20尺後，這個傷害增加到每尺2點揮砍傷害。這些荊棘被砍斷、燒燬或摧毀後會迅速重新生長，它們不能被魔法或能力分開。下臺階移動時不會受到傷害。

numericDifferences.english: The steps from level 1 to level 2 are 33 feet long and rise 20 feet. The stone is crumbling from age and decay. Those who try climbing the steps find that, after the first few, the stone crumbles into gravel beneath them so they can't make any more progress. However much the characters try to climb and demolish the steps, they never seem to get any worse and the gravel never piles up any deeper.
numericDifferences.localized: 從第一層到第二層的臺階長33尺，升高20尺。石頭因年久失修而崩裂。試圖攀爬臺階的人發現，在走了最初的幾步之後，石頭在他們腳下崩解成礫石，因此他們無法再取得更多進展。無論角色們如何嘗試攀爬和拆除臺階，臺階似乎永遠不會變得更糟，礫石也永遠不會堆積得更深。

numericDifferences.english: The steps from level 2 to level 3 (the level of the shrine) are 20 feet long and rise 12 feet. The stairs are in excellent condition, but {@creature Swarm of Poisonous Snakes||swarms of poisonous snakes} slither over them. If snakes are killed, more crawl out through holes in the stone to replace them, so the swarms can never be destroyed or even weakened. No spells or abilities prevent the snakes from attacking someone who climbs the stairs.
numericDifferences.localized: 從第二層到第三層（神殿層）的臺階長20尺，升高12尺。這些臺階狀況極佳，但是{@creature Swarm of Poisonous Snakes||毒蛇群}在臺階上爬行。如果蛇被殺死，會有更多的蛇透過石頭上的洞爬出來替換它們，因此這些蛇群永遠無法被摧毀或甚至削弱。沒有法術或能力可以阻止蛇攻擊爬樓梯的人。

numericDifferences.english: Six {@creature Specter||specters} haunt the forge, three in each chamber. They are all that's left of the mine's dwarven defenders. The first character to enter either chamber is attacked by the specters in that chamber, and those from the adjoining chamber arrive 2 rounds later. The specters can't leave the forge.
numericDifferences.localized: 六個{@creature Specter||惡靈}出沒在鍛造場，每個房間有三個。它們是礦井中矮人守衛的殘餘。第一個進入任一房間的角色將受到該房間內幽靈的攻擊，而來自相鄰房間的幽靈將在兩輪後到達。幽靈不能離開鍛造場。

numericDifferences.english: The Fane of the Night Serpent (see {@area chapter 4|298|x}) lies under the palace. There are two entrances: a large entrance to the north (area 20A) and a hidden entrance to the south (area 20B). Watching over each entrance are three type 1 {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||yuan-ti malisons} in snake form. They slither out of hiding, revert to their true forms, and attack anyone who isn't accompanied by yuan-ti.
numericDifferences.localized: 夜蛇神殿（見{@area 第四章|298|x}]位於宮殿之下。有兩個入口：北邊（區域20A）有一個大入口，南邊（區域20B）有一個隱藏入口。每個入口都有三個第一型態的{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||惡咒蛇人}以蛇的形態守護。它們從隱藏處滑出，恢復到真實形態，攻擊任何沒有元帝族陪同的人。

numericDifferences.english: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} can arrange for captured human characters to be transformed into yuan-ti purebloods so they can roam freely within the temple complex and get closer to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. The transformation can be undone only by a {@spell wish} spell or divine intervention. Characters who survive it gain a random form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). A human that undergoes and survives the ritual retains its traits and gains the following yuan-ti racial traits.
numericDifferences.localized: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}可以安排被捕獲的人類角色被轉變為元帝族純血，以便他們能夠在寺廟建築群內自由漫遊，並更接近{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}。這種轉變只能透過{@spell wish||祈願術}法術或神明的幹預來撤銷。經歷並倖存下來的角色會獲得一種隨機的不定性瘋狂（見《{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}》第八章中的"瘋狂"部分，在《{@i 城主指南}》中）。經歷並倖存下來儀式的人類將保留其特徵，並獲得以下元帝族種族特徵。

numericDifferences.english: Characters who search through the poisons can loot twenty doses of {@item serpent venom|DMG}, five doses of {@item essence of ether|DMG}, and five doses of torpor (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
numericDifferences.localized: 搜尋毒藥的玩家可以掠奪二十劑{@item serpent venom|DMG|蛇毒}、五劑{@item essence of ether|DMG|乙醚精}和五劑麻痺毒藥（詳見{@i 城主指南}第八章"{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}"）。

numericDifferences.english: {@creature Withers|ToA} and his crew use the staircase at {@area area 26|3a3|x} to roam unseen through the tomb's many levels. When their work is done, they retreat to their secret headquarters on level 2 of the tomb ({@area areas 27|3a5|x} and {@area 28|3aa|x}). {@creature Withers|ToA} avoids contact with the characters when possible, confident that {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s traps will defeat them.
numericDifferences.localized: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}和他的船員使用位於{@area 區域26|3a3|x}的樓梯，在墓穴的許多層中無聲息地遊蕩。當他們的工作完成後，他們撤退到墓穴第二層的秘密總部（{@area 區域27|3a5|x}和{@area 28|3aa|x}）。{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}儘可能避免與角色接觸，相信{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的陷阱會擊敗他們。

numericDifferences.english: Level 1: Rotten Halls
numericDifferences.localized: 第一層：腐爛大廳

numericDifferences.english: The warnings {@creature Acererak|ToA} has placed on the obelisk and on the grand staircase ({@area area 7|345|x}) provide clues to overcoming some of the challenges of the tomb. The obelisk's clues pertain to features and locations on level 1, specifically the true entrance ({@area area 4|334|x}), the devil face (area 5B), Obo'laka's tomb ({@area area 10|356|x}), Moa's tomb ({@area area 14|364|x}), and Wongo's tomb ({@area area 16|36f|x}).
numericDifferences.localized: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}在方尖碑和宏偉樓梯（{@area 區域7|345|x}）上放置的警告提供了克服墳墓中一些挑戰的線索。方尖碑的線索涉及第一層的特徵和位置，特別是真正的入口（{@area 區域4|334|x}）、魔鬼面孔（區域 5B）、奧博娜卡的墳墓（{@area 區域10|356|x}）、莫阿的墳墓（{@area 區域14|364|x}）和望戈的墳墓（{@area 區域16|36f|x}）。

numericDifferences.english: A bronze plaque is fixed to the east wall of the balcony on level 2, engraved with another of {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s cryptic warnings in Common. (Give the players a copy of handout 18 in {@area appendix E|537|x}.) It reads as follows:
numericDifferences.localized: 東牆第二層陽臺固定著一塊青銅牌，上面鐫刻著{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的另一道用通用語寫成的神秘警示。（給玩家們發一份位於{@area 附錄 E|537|x}手稿18的內容。）內容如下：

numericDifferences.english: The clues on this plaque pertain to locations on level 2, specifically the gravity ring ({@area area 19|37d|x}), the false tomb ({@area area 20|383|x}), Nangnang's tomb ({@area area 24|398|x}), Papazotl's tomb ({@area area 22|38a|x}), and the devil pit ({@area area 18|37b|x}).
numericDifferences.localized: 這塊牌匾上的線索與第二層的地點有關，具體是重力環（{@area 區域19|37d|x}），假墓（{@area 區域20|383|x}），娜浪的墓穴（{@area 區域24|398|x}），帕帕扎圖的墓穴（{@area 區域22|38a|x}），以及魔鬼坑（{@area 區域18|37b|x}）。

numericDifferences.english: Another bronze plaque appears on the north wall of the balcony on level 3. (Give the players a copy of handout 19 in {@area appendix E|537|x}.) This warning reads as follows:
numericDifferences.localized: 第三層陽臺的北牆上出現了另一塊青銅牌匾。（給玩家一份{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中手冊19的副本。）這個警告內容如下：

numericDifferences.english: The clues on this bronze plaque pertain to features and locations on level 3, specifically the reflected hall ({@area area 31|3ba|x}), the magic font ({@area area 33|3c9|x}), I'jin's tomb ({@area area 35|3d0|x}), the golem pit ({@area area 39|3f0|x}), and Kubazan's tomb ({@area area 42|3fc|x}).
numericDifferences.localized: 這塊青銅牌匾上的線索涉及第三層的特點和地點，具體包括反射大廳（{@area 區域31|3ba|x}），魔法聖洗盆（{@area 區域33|3c9|x}），艾金的墓穴（{@area 區域35|3d0|x}），魔像坑（{@area 區域39|3f0|x}），以及庫巴讚的墓穴（{@area 區域42|3fc|x}）。

numericDifferences.english: The last warning is on a bronze plaque mounted to the west wall of the balcony on level 4. (Give the players a copy of handout 20 in {@area appendix E|537|x}.) It reads as follows:
numericDifferences.localized: 最後一條警告刻在第四層陽臺西牆上的青銅牌匾上。（給玩家一份{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中手冊20的副本。）內容如下：

numericDifferences.english: The clues on this bronze plaque pertain to features and locations on level 4, specifically the elemental traps ({@area area 47|425|x}), Shagambi's tomb ({@area area 48|438|x}), the {@item mirror of life trapping} ({@area area 50|44c|x}), the scepter in the crypt of the Sun Queen ({@area area 53|459|x}), and Unkh's tomb ({@area area 55|465|x}).
numericDifferences.localized: 這塊青銅牌匾上的線索與第四層的特徵和地點有關，特別是元素陷阱（{@area 區域47|425|x}）、莎根比的墓（{@area 區域48|438|x}）、生命陷阱之鏡（{@item mirror of life trapping||攝心鏡}）（{@area 區域50|44c|x}）、太陽女王墓穴中的權杖（{@area 區域53|459|x}）以及安珂的墓（{@area 區域55|465|x}）。

numericDifferences.english: Level 2: Dungeon of Deception
numericDifferences.localized: 第二層：欺騙之迷宮

numericDifferences.english: Map 5.2 shows this level of the dungeon. Mocking devil faces are graven into the walls, and the air reeks of rotting flesh. With no light to nourish it, the vegetation that fills much of level 1 doesn't extend down here.
numericDifferences.localized: 地圖5.2展示了地牢的這一層。牆上刻有嘲笑的魔鬼面孔，空氣中瀰漫著腐爛肉體的惡臭。由於沒有光線滋養，填滿第一層的植被並沒有延伸到這裡。

numericDifferences.english: At the start of round 3, three wine weirds (use {@creature water weird} statistics) flow into the tomb from the northwest, northeast, and southeast cisterns. The weirds attack anyone in the tomb and are {@condition invisible} while fully immersed in wine.
numericDifferences.localized: 在第三輪開始時，三個酒詭（使用{@creature water weird||水詭}的具體數值）從西北、東北和東南的儲水池流入墓穴。這些怪異攻擊墓穴中的任何人，並且在完全浸沒在紅酒中時是{@condition invisible||隱形}的。

numericDifferences.english: Level 3: Vault of Reflection
numericDifferences.localized: 第三層：反思之庫

numericDifferences.english: Level 4: Chambers of Horror
numericDifferences.localized: 第四層：恐怖之室

numericDifferences.english: This dusty room is fifteen feet square and empty except for an ornate, rectangular mirror mounted on the wall opposite the room's only exit.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個塵土飛揚的房間是一個15尺見方的正方形，除了牆上唯一出口對面掛著的一面裝飾華麗的矩形鏡子外，房間裡空無一物。

numericDifferences.english: The stirge attacks A'tan, killing him in 1 round. After draining A'tan's blood, the stirge flies away to digest its meal.
numericDifferences.localized: 蝠翼魔攻擊了阿坦，在一個回合內將其殺死。吸取了阿坦的血液後，蝠翼魔飛走去消化它的獵物。

numericDifferences.english: Level 5: Gears of Hate
numericDifferences.localized: 第五層：仇恨之齒輪

numericDifferences.english: The creature sitting in the armillary chair gains a {@reward charm of heroism} (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
numericDifferences.localized: 坐在渾天椅上的生物獲得一個{@reward charm of heroism||英勇護咒}（參見{@book 超自然贈禮|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}在{@i 城主指南}的第七章）。

numericDifferences.english: Level 6: Cradle of the Death God
numericDifferences.localized: 第六層：死亡之神的搖籃

numericDifferences.english: The skeletons are inanimate remains embedded into the plastered walls. The lectern is held in place by four bolts set deep into the floor and is impervious to damage, spells, and attempts to move it. The book's covers are secured to the lectern with {@i sovereign glue}, preventing it from being easily removed. The eight-page book contains an eight-line nursery rhyme written by the Sewn Sisters in Infernal, with each page bearing one line of the poem. The book is open to pages 4 and 5 when the characters first arrive.
numericDifferences.localized: 這些骷髏是嵌入石膏牆中的無生命遺骸。講臺由四顆深深固定在地板上的螺栓固定，對損害、法術和移動嘗試免疫。書本的封面用{@i 至尊膠}粘在講臺上，防止它被輕易移除。這本八頁的書包含了縫合姐妹用地獄語寫的八行兒歌，每頁承載一行詩。角色們第一次到達時，書是翻到第四和第五頁。

numericDifferences.english: These sociable creatures are curious about humanoids and have little fear of them. A flying monkey that is successfully {@condition grappled}, caught in a {@item net|PHB}, or otherwise prevented from escaping can be trained to perform simple tricks by a character with proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling|PHB} who spends a few hours a day working with the monkey. At the end of 1 week, the character makes a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|PHB}) check. On a success, the flying monkey learns to perform a simple trick on command (such as fetching a specific object or dancing to music). An individual monkey can learn a maximum {@dice 1d6} tricks and can be taught one trick per week.
numericDifferences.localized: 這些社交性生物對人類充滿好奇且幾乎不畏懼。一隻被成功{@condition grappled||被擒}、被{@item net|PHB|捕網}困住或無法逃脫的飛猴，可由具備{@skill Animal Handling|PHB|馴獸}技能的角色透過每天數小時訓練來學會簡單把戲。一週結束時，該角色需進行{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Animal Handling|PHB|馴獸}）檢定。若成功，飛猴將學會按指令表演簡單把戲（如取回特定物品或隨音樂起舞）。單隻飛猴最多可學會{@dice 1d6}個把戲，每週僅能學習一個。

numericDifferences.english: The dancer must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws, and other creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. Each time it takes damage, the dancer can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. When the dancing effect ends, the humanoid suffers the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour.
numericDifferences.localized: 舞者必須耗盡他的移動力在原地跳舞，其攻擊檢定和敏捷豁免均具劣勢。對他發動的攻擊檢定具優勢。每次受到傷害時，舞者可以再次進行該豁免，豁免成功則結束舞蹈效果。當舞蹈效果結束時，該類人生物陷入一小時的{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態中。

numericDifferences.english: The dried leaves of a menga bush can be ground, dissolved in a liquid, heated, and ingested. A creature that ingests 1 ounce of menga leaves in this fashion regains 1 hit point. A creature that ingests more than 5 ounces of menga leaves in a 24-hour period gains no additional benefit and must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour. The {@condition unconscious} creature awakens if it takes at least 5 damage on one turn.
numericDifferences.localized: 曼加叢的幹葉可以磨碎泡水，然後加熱服下。以這種方式服下一盎司曼加葉的生物會恢復 1 點生命值。24 小時內攝入超過 5盎司曼加葉的生物不會再獲得增益，並且必須進行 {@dc 11} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則{@condition unconscious||昏迷} 1 小時。在一輪承受至少 5 點傷害的情況下，陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的生物才會醒來。

numericDifferences.english: Any creature that ingests a ryath root gains {@dice 2d4} temporary hit points. A creature that consumes more than one ryath root in a 24-hour period must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour.
numericDifferences.localized: 吃下雷亞斯根莖的任何生物都會獲得 {@dice 2d4} 點臨時生命值。在 24小時內服用超過一塊雷亞斯根莖的生物需要進行一個 {@dc 13} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則陷入持續一小時的{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。

numericDifferences.english: Fresh sinda berries can be eaten raw or crushed and added to a drink to dull the bitterness. A creature that consumes at least ten fresh sinda berries gains advantage on saving throws against disease and poison for the next 24 hours.
numericDifferences.localized: 新鮮的辛達莓果可以生吃，也可以加入飲品中以沖淡苦味。吃下至少 10 顆新鮮的辛達莓果的生物在接下來的 24 小時內為了抵抗疾病和毒素而進行的豁免檢定具優勢。

numericDifferences.english: Zabou mushrooms feed on offal and the rotting wood of dead trees. If handled carefully, a zabou can be picked or uprooted without causing it to release its spores. If crushed or struck, a zabou releases its spores in a 10-foot-radius sphere. A zabou can also be hurled up to 30 feet away or dropped like a grenade, releasing its cloud of spores on impact. Any creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The {@condition poisoned} creature's skin itches for the duration. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
numericDifferences.localized: 扎孢菇靠攝取內臟和枯樹的腐木的營養為生。謹慎處理的情況下，可以將扎孢菇採摘或拔除並使其不釋放孢子。一旦受到擠壓或是遭到打擊，扎孢菇就會釋放出孢子，覆蓋半徑 10 尺的球形範圍。扎孢菇也可以像手雷一樣被丟出最多 30 尺遠或者原地丟下，在受到衝擊時釋放它的孢子云。位於這片區域內的生物必須進行 {@dc 10} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則{@condition poisoned||中毒}一分鐘。生物在{@condition poisoned||中毒}期間會持續發癢。中毒生物在其每回合結束時可以重複該豁免，豁免成功則結束該狀態。
